comparison.objective: Safely commission a damper on an isolated axis vs reject an unsafe stove instruction by operating gas isolation.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key/collar manipulation plus guarded cycling vs recognizing an alarm and pressing a latching shutoff without touching ignition controls.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeatable carriage stops and a locked setting vs shutoff latched for one second with no ignition action.
comparison.reason: Physical control actuation is generic; the stove task principally tests safety override and plunger operation. Missing rubric detail: exact fixture constraints are delegated to SCORING.md, but no ambiguity affects novelty.
